053 *  <p>{@summary The implementation for the interface
054 *  {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerfLogManager}.}</p>

056 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org

062@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerfLogManagerImpl.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $" )
063@API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.25.0" )
064public final class PerfLogManagerImpl implements PerfLogManager
065{
066        /*---------------*\
067    ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
068        \*---------------*/
069    /**
070     *  <p>{@summary The janitor that takes care of the housekeeping for an
071     *  instance of
072     *  {@link PerfLogManager}
073     *  in case that was not properly closed.}</p>
074     *
075     *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
076     *  @version $Id: PerfLogManagerImpl.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $
077     *  @since 0.25.0
078     *
079     *  @param  scheduledExecutorService    The reference to the
080     *      {@link ScheduledExecutorService}
081     *      that needs to be terminated.
082     *
083     *  @UMLGraph.link
084     */
085    @SuppressWarnings( "NewClassNamingConvention" )
086    @ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerfLogManagerImpl.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $" )
087    @API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.25.0" )
088    private record Janitor( ScheduledExecutorService scheduledExecutorService ) implements Runnable
089    {
090            /*---------*\
091        ====** Methods **======================================================
092            \*---------*/
093        /**
094         *  {@inheritDoc}
095         */
096        @Override
097        public final void run()
098        {
099            if( nonNull( scheduledExecutorService ) && !scheduledExecutorService.isTerminated() )
100            {
101                scheduledExecutorService.shutdownNow();
102            }
103        }   //  run()
104    }
105    //  record Janitor
106
107        /*------------*\
108    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
109        \*------------*/
110    /**
111     *  The
112     *  {@link Cleanable}
113     *  for this instance.
114     */
115    private final Cleanable m_Cleanable;
116
117    /**
118     *  The flag the indicates whether this manager is (still) active.
119     */
120    private boolean m_IsActive;
121
122    /**
123     *  The caretaker for this instance.
124     */
125    @SuppressWarnings( "FieldCanBeLocal" )
126    private final Janitor m_Janitor;
127
128    /**
129     *  The proxy for the
130     *  {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerfLogMBean}.
131     */
132    private final PerfLogMBean m_MBean;
133
134    /**
135     *  The timeout scheduler for this manager.
136     */
137    private final ScheduledExecutorService m_TimeoutScheduler;
138
139        /*------------------------*\
140    ====** Static Initialisations **===========================================
141        \*------------------------*/
142    /**
143     *  The cleaner that is used to finalise instances of
144     *  {@code PerfLogManagerImpl}.
145     */
146    private static final Cleaner m_Cleaner = Cleaner.create();
147
148    /**
149     *  The instance of
150     *  {@link MathContext}
151     *  that is used by
152     *  {@link #registerTimeoutMonitor(PerformanceTrackerImpl)}
153     *  to calculate the timeout waiting period from the given
154     *  {@link org.tquadrat.foundation.value.TimeValue}.
155     */
156    private static final MathContext MATH_CONTEXT = new MathContext( 32, CEILING );
157
158        /*--------------*\
159    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
160        \*--------------*/
161    /**
162     *  Creates a new instance of {@code PerfLogManagerImpl}.
163     *
164     *  @param  mbeanServer The MBean server that is used.
165     *  @param  objectName  The name of the
166     *      {@link PerfLogMBean}.
167     */
168    public PerfLogManagerImpl( final MBeanServer mbeanServer, final ObjectName objectName )
169    {
170        this( false, mbeanServer, objectName, null );
171    }   //  PerfLogManagerImpl()
172
173    /**
174     *  Creates a new instance of {@code PerfLogManagerImpl}.
175     *
176     *  @param  mbeanServer The MBean server that is used.
177     *  @param  objectName  The name of the
178     *      {@link PerfLogMBean}.
179     *  @param  uncaughtExceptionHandler    The implementation of
180     *      {@link Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler}
181     *      that is used for the timeout monitoring thread.
182     */
183    @SuppressWarnings( "MethodParameterNamingConvention" )
184    public PerfLogManagerImpl( final MBeanServer mbeanServer, final ObjectName objectName, final UncaughtExceptionHandler uncaughtExceptionHandler )
185    {
186        this( false, mbeanServer, objectName, requireNonNullArgument( uncaughtExceptionHandler, "uncaughtExceptionHandler" ) );
187    }   //  PerfLogManagerImpl()
188
189    /**
190     *  Creates a new instance of {@code PerfLogManagerImpl}.
191     *
192     *  @param  ignored Discriminator
193     *  @param  mbeanServer The MBean server that is used.
194     *  @param  objectName  The name of the
195     *      {@link PerfLogMBean}.
196     *  @param  uncaughtExceptionHandler    The implementation of
197     *      {@link Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler}
198     *      that is used for the timeout monitoring thread.
199     */
200    @SuppressWarnings( "MethodParameterNamingConvention" )
201    private PerfLogManagerImpl( final boolean ignored, final MBeanServer mbeanServer, final ObjectName objectName, final UncaughtExceptionHandler uncaughtExceptionHandler )
202    {
203        //---* Connect to the MBean *------------------------------------------
204        m_MBean = connectToMBean( mbeanServer, objectName );
205
206        //---* Create the timeout scheduler *----------------------------------
207        m_TimeoutScheduler = createTimeoutMonitor( uncaughtExceptionHandler );
208
209        //---* Register the timeout monitor for housekeeping *-----------------
210        m_Janitor = new Janitor( m_TimeoutScheduler );
211        //noinspection ThisEscapedInObjectConstruction
212        m_Cleanable = m_Cleaner.register( this, m_Janitor );
213
214        m_IsActive = true;
215    }   //  PerfLogManagerImpl()
216
217        /*---------*\
218    ====** Methods **==========================================================
219        \*---------*/
220    /**
221     *  <p>{@summary Checks whether this performance logging manager is still
222     *  active.} Throws an
223     *  {@link IllegalStateException}
224     *  if not.
225     *
226     *  @return {@code true} if the manager is still active.
227     *  @throws IllegalStateException
228     *      {@link #close()}
229     *      was already called on this instance.
230     */
231    @SuppressWarnings( "UnusedReturnValue" )
232    private final boolean checkActive() throws IllegalStateException
233    {
234        if( !m_IsActive ) throw new IllegalStateException( "PerfLogManager was already terminated" );
235
236        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
237        //noinspection ConstantValue
238        return m_IsActive;
239    }   //  checkActive()
240
241    /**
242     *  {@inheritDoc}
243     */
244    @Override
245    public final void close()
246    {
247        if( m_IsActive )
248        {
249            m_Cleanable.clean();
250            m_IsActive = false;
251        }
252    }   //  close()
253
254    /**
255     *  <p>{@summary Establishes the connection with the
256     *  {@link PerfLogMBean}
257     *  on the given
258     *  {@linkplain MBeanServer MBean server}
259     *  and returns a proxy for it.}</p>
260     *  <p>If the MBean had not been registered yet, this method will register
261     *  it first.</p>
262     *
263     *  @param  mbeanServer The MBean server that is used.
264     *  @param  objectName  The name for the MBean.
265     *  @return A proxy for
266     *      {@link PerfLogMBean}.
267     */
268    private static final PerfLogMBean connectToMBean( final MBeanServer mbeanServer, final ObjectName objectName )
269    {
270        final PerfLogMBean retValue;
271        if( !requireNonNullArgument( mbeanServer, "mbeanServer" ).isRegistered( requireNonNullArgument( objectName, "objectName" ) ) )
272        {
273            final var mbean = new PerfLogMBeanImpl();
274            try
275            {
276                mbeanServer.registerMBean( mbean, objectName );
277            }
278            catch( final InstanceAlreadyExistsException _ )
279            {
280                /*
281                 * Someone else was faster to register the MBean. We ignore the
282                 * exception and try to create the proxy.
283                 */
284            }
285            catch( final MBeanRegistrationException e )
286            {
287                throw new UnexpectedExceptionError( e );
288            }
289            catch( final NotCompliantMBeanException e )
290            {
291                throw new ImpossibleExceptionError( e );
292            }
293        }
294        retValue = newMBeanProxy( mbeanServer, objectName, PerfLogMBean.class );
295
296        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
297        return retValue;
298    }   //  connectToMBean
299
300    /**
301     *  {@inheritDoc}
302     */
303    @Override
304    public final Optional<PerformanceTracker> createPerformanceTracker( final PerformanceSectionName name )
305    {
306        checkActive();
307
308        final var performanceSection = m_MBean.retrievePerformanceSection( requireNonNullArgument( name, "name" ) );
309
310        final Optional<PerformanceTracker> retValue;
311        if( performanceSection.isIgnored() )
312        {
313            retValue = Optional.empty();
314        }
315        else
316        {
317            final var tracker = new PerformanceTrackerImpl( this, performanceSection );
318            // TODO - Implement the registration for the timeout!
319            retValue = Optional.of( tracker );
320        }
321
322        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
323        return retValue;
324    }   //  createPerformanceTracker()
325
326    /**
327     *  Creates the
328     *  {@link ScheduledExecutorService}
329     *  instance that is used as the timeout monitor and registers it for the
330     *  housekeeping.
331     *
332     *  @param  uncaughtExceptionHandler    The implementation of
333     *      {@link Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler}
334     *      that is used for the timeout monitoring threads.
335     *  @return The timeout monitor.
336     */
337    @SuppressWarnings( "MethodParameterNamingConvention" )
338    private final ScheduledExecutorService createTimeoutMonitor( final UncaughtExceptionHandler uncaughtExceptionHandler )
339    {
340        //---* Create the ScheduledExecutorService *---------------------------
341        final var threadName = "TimeoutMonitor";
342        final var builder = Thread.ofVirtual()
343            .name( threadName );
344        if( nonNull( uncaughtExceptionHandler ) ) builder.uncaughtExceptionHandler( uncaughtExceptionHandler);
345        final var retValue = newScheduledThreadPool( 1, builder.factory() );
346
347        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
348        return retValue;
349    }   //  createTimeoutMonitor()
350
351    /**
352     *  <p>{@summary Provides a reference to the internal instance of
353     *  {@link PerfLogMBean}.}</p>
354     *
355     *  @note This is the proxy, but <i>not</i> the MBean itself.
356     *  @note The API is not limited to the OpenMBean API that is published to
357     *      a remote client.
358     *
359     *  @return The reference to the MBean.
360     */
361    @SuppressWarnings( "PublicMethodNotExposedInInterface" )
362    public final PerfLogMBean getMBean() { return m_MBean; }
363
364    /**
365     *  {@inheritDoc}
366     */
367    @Override
368    public final Optional<PerformanceSection> getPerformanceSection( final PerformanceSectionName name )
369    {
370        checkActive();
371
372        final var retValue = m_MBean.getPerformanceSection( requireNonNullArgument( name, "name" ) );
373
374        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------

378    /**
379     *  {@inheritDoc}
380     */
381    @SuppressWarnings( "NewMethodNamingConvention" )
382    @Override
383    public void loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions( final Iterable<PerformanceSection> definitions )
384    {
385        checkActive();
386
387        for( final var definition : requireNonNullArgument( definitions, "definitions" ) )
388        {
389            m_MBean.addPerformanceSection( definition );
390        }
391    }   //  loadPerformanceSectionDefinitions
392
393    /**
394     *  Registers a timeout monitor from a performance tracker.
395     *
396     *  @param  tracker The performance tracker to register.
397     *  @return The timeout monitor; will be {@code null} if the given tracker
398     *      is not active, or the performance section for that tracker does
399     *      not define a timeout value.
400     *  @throws IllegalStateException
401     *      {@link #close()}
402     *      was already called on this instance.
403     */
404    @SuppressWarnings( "PublicMethodNotExposedInInterface" )
405    public final ScheduledFuture<?> registerTimeoutMonitor( final PerformanceTrackerImpl tracker ) throws IllegalStateException
406    {
407        checkActive();
408
409        ScheduledFuture<?> retValue = null;
410        final var section = requireNonNullArgument( tracker, "tracker" ).getPerformanceSection();
411        final var timeout = section.getTimeout();
412        if( tracker.isActive() && timeout.isPresent() )
413        {
414            final var unit = MILLISECOND;
415            final var timeoutValue = timeout.get().convert( unit ).round( MATH_CONTEXT ).longValue();
416            retValue = m_TimeoutScheduler.schedule( () -> tracker.abort( true ), timeoutValue, unit.getTimeUnit() );
417        }
418
419        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
420        return retValue;
421    }   //  registerTimeoutMonitor()
422
423    /**
424     *  Sends a performance report to the
425     *  {@link PerfLogMBean}.
426     *
427     *  @param  tracker The tracker that collected the performance data.
428     *  @param  message The message describing the reason for the abort of the
429     *      tracker; can be {@code null}.
430     *  @param  cause   The exception that caused the abort; can be
431     *      {@code null}.
432     *  @throws IllegalStateException
433     *      {@link #close()}
434     *      was already called on this instance.
435     */
436    @SuppressWarnings( "PublicMethodNotExposedInInterface" )
437    public final void sendReport( final PerformanceTrackerImpl tracker, final String message, final Throwable cause ) throws IllegalStateException
438    {
439        if( checkActive() && nonNull( tracker ) )
440        {
441            final var report = new PerformanceReportImpl( tracker, message, cause );
442            final var section = tracker.getPerformanceSection();
443            final var sendReportForAbort = section.isSendingReportForAbort();
444            @SuppressWarnings( "LocalVariableNamingConvention" )
445            final var sendReportOnlyForThresholdExceeded = section.isSendingReportOnlyForExceededThreshold();
446            final var isTimedOut = tracker.isTimedOut();
447            final var isThresholdExceeded = tracker.isThresholdExceeded();
448            final var elapsedTime = tracker.getElapsedTime();
449            switch( tracker.getStatus() )
450            {
451                case STATUS_ABORTED ->
452                {
453                    if( isTimedOut || sendReportForAbort )
454                    {
455                        m_MBean.receivePerformanceReport( report );
456                    }
457                }
458
459                case STATUS_STOPPED ->
460                {
461                    if( elapsedTime.isPresent() && (!sendReportOnlyForThresholdExceeded || isThresholdExceeded) )
462                    {
463                        m_MBean.receivePerformanceReport( report );
464                    }
465                }
466
467                default -> { /* Do nothing – although this case should never happen */ }
468            }
469        }
470    }   //  sendReport()
471}
